The pedestrian network uses shared OSM node IDs. Paths with pedestrian or
general access restrictions are filtered according to their mapped tags.
Venue positions are from the linked OSM features, and the dashed approach
connects each mapped position to its nearest point on the walking network.
Estimated walking times use 4.5 km/h. Government sources for venue names and
addresses are linked in city-places.json and in the place panel.

Leaflet is distributed under its accompanying BSD licence.
